meta.title: Magnetic Flux Converter — Convert Weber and More
meta.description: Free magnetic flux converter for 4+ units including Weber, Milliweber, Microweber. Instant, accurate, browser-based.

content.intro: Weber, maxwell. Convert between 4 magnetic flux units instantly, with engineering-grade precision and no signup required.
content.result_section: Pick any two units below to convert between them. The base unit for magnetic flux in this tool is **Wb**; every conversion routes through it for consistency.
content.formula_section: Most magnetic flux conversions are a single multiplication by a fixed factor. Temperature is the notable exception — it uses additive offsets, not just multiplication. The converter handles both transparently.
content.conversion_table:
| Unit | Symbol |
| --- | --- |
| Weber | Wb |
| Milliweber | mWb |
| Microweber | µWb |
| Maxwell | Mx |
content.use_cases:
- MRI, NMR, and scientific-instrument field strength.
- Magnet selection for industrial holding applications.
- Sensor calibration in gauss vs tesla.
- Audio and speaker magnet specs.
- Magnetic shielding design.
content.tips:
Bookmark the conversions you use most — each pair has its own dedicated page with formulas, a lookup table, and FAQs.

When working with derived units (area, volume), remember the factor scales with the dimension: a length factor f becomes f² for area and f³ for volume.
content.faq:
**Q:** How accurate is this magnetic flux converter?
**A:** It uses 4 canonical unit definitions and 12-digit precision constants.

**Q:** Is it free?
**A:** Yes — completely free, no signup, no limits.

**Q:** Which units are supported?
**A:** Weber (Wb), Milliweber (mWb), Microweber (µWb), Maxwell (Mx).
